windows.why: A full arc: Rs 50,000 gone in three months, crying outside the shop, the insight that success is a small daily act, the one-call-a-day habit, the grandmother who sent fifteen customers, 10x result. The intro and subscribe request in the first 20 s must be cut.

Starts mid-story and ends in sponsor read and filler; the 'if you have no money, invest time' section (S17-S22) is a decent standalone idea with a clear question and a payoff, but weaker than window 0.

The three rules plus the Rs 12 lakh debt and 'nothing is impossible, only consistency is needed' land cleanly from S26 to S33; the opening lines are a sponsor read and filler and must not be included.
